# LazyZCode

> The discipline layer for ZCode: plan → execute → take evidence → never stop
> half-done. An npm-installable plugin (skills, hooks, read-only discipline
> agents) plus a lightweight `lzy` CLI that add a goal-loop state machine, a
> decision-complete plan gate, real-surface evidence bound to git tree hashes,
> and a Stop-hook pull-back to the ZCode coding agent. MIT licensed, zero
> telemetry, macOS first.

Install: `npm i -g lazyzcode && lzy install` (needs the ZCode desktop app,
Node ≥ 22, git).
